business_problem: ADNOC sought to improve subsurface mapping, drilling, production, and reservoir management; reduce unplanned equipment shutdowns and emissions; and enhance safety across its energy value chain.
solution_summary: ADNOC integrated more than 30 AI tools across field operations and corporate decision-making. Upstream applications map subsurface resources, optimize drilling and production, and support reservoir management; the source does not name those underlying tools. Centralized Predictive Analytics and Diagnostics (CPAD) remotely monitors critical equipment at upstream and downstream facilities to reduce unplanned shutdowns and streamline maintenance. Emission X gathers historical and real-time data from hundreds of operational-site sources, predicts emission sources up to five years ahead, and supports preventive action by operators. AIQ's SMARTi uses computer vision to detect safety hazards; AR360 visualizes reservoirs and optimizes development; Robowell remotely operates flow valves and other upstream equipment. Panorama Digital Command Center provides operational insights across ADNOC's value chain, while Thamama Subsurface Center of Excellence uses AI to harness subsurface resources. The article does not identify storage, cloud, or system-integration technologies.
